clips.title: The story
paras: Along Baradin Bay, salty spray sweeps across Saltspray Glen, where wild raptors roam the lowland. The glen lies between murloc waters and ancient dwarven ruins.

In the Wetlands' far northwest, salty spray blows inland across Saltspray Glen from Baradin Bay. Bluegill Marsh and its murloc-haunted waters lie to the south, while the quiet bluffs of Ironbeard's Tomb rise to the east. Cunning wild raptors nest through the marshy grass and hunt across the brackish flats. Their kin range nearby at Raptor Ridge and Black Channel Marsh, leaving little comfort for travelers passing through.
